![RXP Dock logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/speedlnq1/RXPDock/main/logo.png)

# RXP Dock

**Quests | RestedXP | Polestar tabs on top of the Questie quest tracker.**
One panel at a time, in the same spot. Made for WoW Forever.

> Unofficial. Not made by or affiliated with RestedXP, Questie or Polestar.

## Features
- Three tabs above the Questie tracker: **Quests**, **RestedXP** and **Polestar**.
- **Polestar tab (new in 1.1.0):** the Polestar guide window docks in the same spot. Polestar is optional: no Polestar, the tab just shows your quests.
- The RestedXP guide sits right under the tabs, where your quest list is.
- **RestedXP never pauses.** On the Quests tab the guide is only made invisible and click-through, so steps keep tracking and quests keep auto accepting and turning in.
- Never an empty slot: if Questie has nothing to show (no quests, in a dungeon), RestedXP shows instead. If RestedXP is closed, Questie shows.
- Works with RestedXP's normal window and its beta "V2" window.
- Safe in combat: no "action blocked" errors. A tab switch in combat happens when combat ends.
- Remembers your tab for each character.

## Install
1. Download the zip from Releases.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\` so you get `AddOns\RXPDock\`.
3. Fully restart the game.

Also on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rxp-dock).

Needs **Questie** (with its tracker on) and **RestedXP Guides**.

## Use
- Click **Quests**, **RestedXP** or **Polestar**.
- `/rxpdock` switches to the next tab.
- **Ctrl + drag the tab bar** to move everything (tabs, tracker and guide). Questie saves the spot.

## Good to know
- The RestedXP window is docked, so dragging it snaps back. Move the dock with Ctrl + drag on the tabs.
- On the Quests tab, RestedXP's tip boxes and timer bars are hidden too. The quest item button, target buttons and arrow stay.
- For a plainer look: `/rxp` → Choose Theme → DarkMode.

releases.notes:
- New **Polestar** tab: the Polestar guide window docks under the tabs too. Its guide keeps running on the other tabs.
- `/rxpdock` now cycles Quests → RestedXP → Polestar.
- The tab bar is as wide as the window it sits on, so the RestedXP guide no longer gets pushed off the screen edge.
